name: Vijayan Warrier
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Atrial fibrillation with heart failure reduced ejection fraction. Patient reports mild exertional dyspnoea, no orthopnea. BP 128/78, HR 78 regular, lungs clear, S1S2 normal, no murmurs, no peripheral oedema. ECG shows AF with controlled ventricular rate. Echocardiogram shows EF 38%, NYHA II.
